customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of excellent quality and reliable, with prompt installation and good value for money. The water quality after purification is amazing, and customers appreciate its taste, with one noting it increases water sweetness. They find it easy to use and professional, though opinions about service are mixed, with some praising it while others report very bad service.

reviews.author: Vishnu Raj
reviews.title: Excellent Product, Poor Installation Partner Support
reviews.body: The product itself is excellent and offers great value for money. The build quality is good, it works perfectly, and I'm very satisfied with the purchase. However, my experience with the installation partner was disappointing. It's been 13 days since the product was delivered, and I didn't receive any response or installation appointment from the assigned installation partner despite waiting. Eventually, I contacted my local Eureka Forbes service centre directly, and they arranged the installation free of charge. So, I'd definitely give 5 stars for the product, but a poor rating for the instal

reviews.author: Ashish
reviews.title: Aquaguard Installation experience
reviews.body: The service technician arrived on time, which I appreciate. However, the installation was done in a hurry, and he left without checking whether the water purifier was working properly. Shortly after the installation, the purifier started leaking and is still not usable. Additionally, I was charged ₹800 for two new parts required for the installation. I requested an invoice for these parts, but I have still not received one. Overall, the installation experience was disappointing. I hope the issue is resolved quickly and the invoice is provided.

reviews.author: Radha
reviews.title: Good quality and very convenient
reviews.body: I liked the product; it purifies the water well. It also looks good, and the best part is that Eureka Forbes sends someone for the installation, which I really liked

reviews.author: Chandan Yadav
reviews.title: Budget friendly
reviews.body: Product is good and working fine as of now after one week. It make some sound while working but remain silent afterwards

reviews.author: xyz
reviews.title: Buy the Aquasaver 2x model instead
reviews.body: If only the Amazon listing had clearly mentioned the differences between this model and Aquasaver 2x, I would have chosen that instead. This model doesn't include a sediment filter in the box, but the Aquasaver 2x does. The installation technician told me that I definitely need one. The sediment filter cost ₹1300. The filter life of this model is 1 year compared to the 2-year filter life of the other model. With the price difference between the models being ₹2000, by the end of the first year, this model would be more expensive than the 2x model.
